Setup.Name: Escaping characters
Setup.Description: Showcases escaping characters in a grok expression.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Server logs"
    Description: "Collect all log messages from the server. Demonstrates how to escape characters in GROK-expressions."
    Mqtt:
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/log"
    Otel:
      Logs:
        - PayloadType: Json
          Transform: "GROK('%{DATA:otel_timestamp} \\\\[%{DATA:otel_loglevel}\\\\] \\\\[%{DATA:server_name}\\\\] %{GREEDYDATA:otel_message}')"
